styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the Andy Warhol Museum and the Carnegie halls.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Primanti sandwiches, pierogies and Strip District markets.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Inclines, riverfront trails and hilltop views.

stays.why: Walk to Point State Park, the inclines and the ballparks. Free T rides inside downtown.
Food markets, cafés and the riverfront trail on the doorstep; short walk or bus to downtown.
Bars and restaurants on East Carson Street; walk over the bridge to downtown sights.
Next to the universities, museums and Phipps Conservatory; quieter evenings.

food: Order a Primanti Bros. sandwich: meat, fries and coleslaw stacked inside the bread.
Try pierogies and Polish plates in the Strip District and Lawrenceville.
Strip District on a Saturday morning: coffee, bakeries and food stalls; go early, it gets busy.
Cheap eats: a slice of pizza or a hoagie for roughly $8–15; sit-down dinners run about $20–40 a head.
Book ahead for popular Lawrenceville and Downtown restaurants on weekend evenings.
more_time: Ride both inclines: Duquesne for the classic view, Monongahela for a quieter one. Fare is $2.75 each way.
Add a half-day at the Carnegie Museum of Natural History and the Andy Warhol Museum in Oakland and the North Shore.
Sports fans: check the Pirates, Steelers or Penguins schedule; tickets vary, so check on the day.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the museums, the inclines and a Strip District food morning; add a night for a ballgame or a day trip.

month_notes: January is cold: highs near 3°C, lows around -5°C, with about 13 wet days. Pack a warm coat.
February stays cold, highs near 6°C and lows near -4°C; ice is possible on steps and trails.
March warms to highs near 11°C but is wet, about 14 rain days. Bring a rain jacket.
April is mild, highs near 16°C, with about 15 rain days. Good for walking between showers.
May is pleasant, highs near 22°C and lows near 11°C. A great month for the parks and trails.
June is warm, highs near 26°C, with about 16 rain days, the wettest month. Keep an umbrella handy.
July is the hottest month: highs near 29°C, lows near 19°C. Plan outdoor sights for morning.
August is hot and humid, highs near 28°C. Carry water and take shade breaks.
September cools to highs near 25°C with fewer rain days, about 11. Comfortable for sightseeing.
October is crisp, highs near 18°C and lows near 9°C. Fall colours on the hills; a favourite month.
November cools to highs near 11°C with about 10 rain days. Layer up for the inclines.
December is cold, highs near 7°C and lows near -1°C, with about 12 wet days. Expect grey skies.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold, grey winters and warm, humid summers, with rain spread through the year.

items.title: Best time: May to October
items.text: Highs run about 18–29°C. May, September and October are the most comfortable for walking.

items.title: Winter is cold (December to February)
items.text: Highs near 3–7°C and lows down to about -5°C. Snow and ice are possible; wear warm, grippy shoes.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 10–16 wet days every month, peaking in spring and early summer. Pack a light rain jacket.

items.title: Humid summers
items.text: July and August highs near 28–29°C with muggy air. Do hilltop views and trails early in the day.

items.title: Crisp autumn
items.text: October highs near 18°C and cool nights. Good light and fall colours on the hills.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof jacket and comfortable walking shoes for hills and steps; a warm coat and hat in winter.

transit.best: Walk downtown and ride the free T there; use buses, the T or ride apps for hills and river crossings.

modes.text: Light rail ('The T') serves downtown, the North Shore and the south. Free downtown between Allegheny and First Avenue stations.
Buses reach most neighbourhoods. Fare is $2.75 with ConnectCard or app; cash needs exact change. A $7 day pass gives unlimited rides, and tickets allow transfers for three hours.
Uber and Lyft are widely used and often cheaper than taxis. Street hailing is hard, so book in the app.
Handy for day trips, but hills and rivers make driving confusing. A GPS helps.
Downtown is walkable, but expect hills and steps. The two inclines are a paid ride, not a walk.
Two historic inclines climb the hills for views. Fare is $2.75 with ConnectCard or app; cash exact fare.
